summary: Email thread capture feature testing complete. All 27 backend tests pass. Unit tests verify _parse_email_date correctly parses RFC 2822 dates (IST, UTC) to UTC and falls back to datetime.now(UTC) for missing/malformed dates. _fetch_full_thread returns empty list gracefully when IMAP is None. _create_ticket_from_email accepts email_date, mail, gmail_thrid parameters. API regression tests confirm /api/tickets and /api/portal/categories work correctly.

success_rate.frontend: N/A - no frontend changes in this feature

context_for_next_testing_agent: Email thread capture feature fully tested via unit tests. Real IMAP integration cannot be tested without credentials but function signatures, date parsing, and error handling are verified. Key functions: _parse_email_date (RFC 2822 to UTC), _fetch_full_thread (Gmail X-GM-THRID search), _store_thread_record, _create_ticket_from_email (with email_date, mail, gmail_thrid params). Test user: test@emergent.sh with session_token=test_kb_session_token.

_parse_email_date_ist.details: Parses IST (+0530) dates to UTC correctly. Example: 10:30 IST -> 05:00 UTC

_parse_email_date_utc.details: Parses UTC (+0000) dates correctly, returns timezone.utc

_parse_email_date_missing.details: Falls back to datetime.now(UTC) when Date header is missing

_parse_email_date_malformed.details: Handles malformed date strings without crashing, returns fallback

_fetch_full_thread_none_imap.details: Returns empty list [] when IMAP connection is None (graceful error handling)

_store_thread_record_exists.details: Function exists and has expected signature (tm, ticket_id, match_method)

_create_ticket_from_email_params.details: Accepts email_date, mail, gmail_thrid parameters without error

parsedate_to_datetime_import.details: email_poller imports parsedate_to_datetime from email.utils correctly

api_portal_categories_kb_group_key.details: GET /api/portal/categories returns categories with kb_group_key field
